digital_signature.description: Provides data authenticity, integrity, and non-repudiation.
digital_signature.threat_context: Vulnerable to forgery once CRQC is available. Long-lived signed contracts, firmware updates, and identity assertions require migration.
digital_signature.sndl_exposure: Low (Signatures cannot be retroactively broken to expose secrecy of past data, but future forgery of credentials/updates is critical)

key_establishment.description: Securely establishes shared secret keys across untrusted channels.
key_establishment.threat_context: IMMEDIATE threat from Store-Now-Decrypt-Later (SNDL) attacks. Encrypted traffic intercepted today can be decrypted once CRQC is operational.

encryption.description: Protects confidentiality of sensitive data at rest or in transit.
encryption.pqc_target_primitive: AES-256 (for symmetric) or ML-KEM/hybrid (for asymmetric envelope)
encryption.threat_context: If asymmetric (e.g. RSA-OAEP), critical SNDL vulnerability. If symmetric (AES-128), vulnerable to Grover search speedup; upgrade to AES-256.

decryption.description: Recovers plaintext from ciphertext using corresponding keys.
decryption.pqc_target_primitive: Corresponding PQC KEM decapsulation or symmetric cipher
decryption.threat_context: Tied directly to encryption primitive risks.

hashing.description: One-way digest generation for integrity, commitment, or indexing.
hashing.threat_context: Classical collision vulnerabilities (MD5, SHA-1) require immediate hygiene remediation. SHA-2/SHA-3 are quantum-safe.

password_hashing.description: Memory-hard, salted key derivation functions for authentication secrets.
password_hashing.threat_context: Quantum computers provide speedup against weak KDFs; memory-hardness remains strong defense.

certificate.description: Binds public keys to entities using digital signatures in PKI.
certificate.threat_context: All certificates with RSA or ECDSA public keys become untrusted under CRQC.

random_generation.description: Generates cryptographically unpredictable entropy and keys.
random_generation.pqc_target_primitive: CTR-DRBG with AES-256, HMAC-DRBG with SHA-384
random_generation.threat_context: Must maintain 256-bit internal state to prevent quantum state reconstruction.

protocol_security.description: Multi-phase cryptographic protocol securing network communications.
protocol_security.threat_context: Immediate risk to session confidentiality via SNDL.

unknown.description: Cryptographic primitive detected without unambiguous usage context.
